name: Lavender Dusk
summary: A calm floral blend of lavender and soft musk.
description: Hand poured soy wax scented with French lavender, a lift of bergamot and a warm base of white musk. It burns slowly and fills a room with a gentle, evening calm.

name: Orange Grove
summary: Sun warmed orange peel with a green leaf edge.
description: Sweet orange and mandarin open bright, then settle into neroli and a touch of green leaf. A candle for kitchens and sunny mornings.

name: Sea Salt & Cedar
summary: Coastal air over a clean cedar base.
description: Crisp sea salt and driftwood sit on top of dry cedar and a hint of ambergris. Clean, cool and quietly woody.

name: Vanilla Ember
summary: Creamy vanilla bean warmed by glowing embers.
description: Madagascan vanilla and tonka bean wrapped in a soft smoky amber. It reads like a fireside dessert.

name: Cedar Smoke
summary: Dry cedarwood with a trail of campfire smoke.
description: Atlas cedar, smoked birch and a thread of black tea give this candle a deep and grounded character. Made for cool evenings.

name: Honey Oat
summary: Warm honey stirred through toasted oats.
description: Wildflower honey, toasted oats and a spoonful of cream. Comforting, soft and a little sweet.

name: Rose Quartz
summary: Fresh cut rose petals on a pale musk.
description: Damask rose and peony are softened by pink pepper and clean musk. A polished floral that stays light.

name: Fig & Cassis
summary: Ripe fig and blackcurrant over green florals.
description: Juicy fig and cassis meet fig leaf and a faint petal sweetness. Fruity without being heavy.

name: Ember & Clove
summary: Glowing clove and orange peel on dark amber.
description: Clove bud, cinnamon bark and a curl of orange peel over resinous amber. A small batch that sells out quickly.

name: Midnight Jasmine
summary: Heady night blooming jasmine with a dark green finish.
description: Jasmine sambac and tuberose open slowly into sandalwood. Rich, nocturnal and best enjoyed in a quiet room.

name: Last Light
summary: Sandalwood and soft leather at the end of the day.
description: Creamy sandalwood, suede and a drop of vanilla bean. The final few jars of this batch are all that remain.

name: Peony Blush
summary: Soft peony with a dusting of pink sugar.
description: Full peony petals, lychee and white tea layered over a gentle musk. Light, rosy and easy to live with.

name: White Orchid
summary: Creamy orchid with coconut milk and pear.
description: A smooth white orchid with a note of ripe pear and a base of soft coconut milk. Elegant and rounded.

name: Garden Violet
summary: Powdery violet leaves and fresh cut stems.
description: Violet, iris root and green stems give a powdery floral with a cool, damp garden feel.

name: Smoked Oak
summary: Charred oak barrels and a wisp of tobacco leaf.
description: Seasoned oak, toasted vanilla and dried tobacco leaf. A deep scent for libraries and long evenings.

name: Birch & Pine
summary: Crisp pine needles on pale birch wood.
description: Fir balsam, silver birch and a trace of moss. Bright and resinous, like a walk in a cold forest.

name: Sandalwood Hush
summary: Milky sandalwood wrapped in warm cashmere.
description: Mysore style sandalwood, cashmere wood and a whisper of cardamom. Smooth, quiet and long lasting.

name: Driftwood Amber
summary: Sun bleached driftwood with golden amber.
description: Salt dried wood, golden amber and a drop of fig. Warm and weathered.

name: Citrus Morning
summary: Lemon zest and grapefruit for a bright start.
description: Sparkling lemon, pink grapefruit and a sprig of basil. A clean wake up for any room.

name: Cool Linen
summary: Fresh laundry dried in a light breeze.
description: Clean cotton, white lily and a hint of aldehyde. It smells like crisp sheets.

name: Rain Meadow
summary: Wet grass and wild clover after a summer shower.
description: Petrichor, clover and dewy green grass with a light mineral edge. Open, airy and calming.

name: Mint & Cucumber
summary: Cold pressed cucumber and garden mint.
description: Cucumber water, spearmint and a pinch of sea fennel. Cooling and light.

name: Caramel Fudge
summary: Buttery caramel poured over dark fudge.
description: Slow cooked caramel, cocoa and a pinch of sea salt. Sweet, rich and indulgent.

name: Toasted Almond
summary: Roasted almonds and warm marzipan.
description: Toasted almond, marzipan and a trace of cherry. Nutty and gently sweet.

name: Cocoa Hearth
summary: Hot cocoa with a hint of cinnamon sugar.
description: Dark cocoa, roasted hazelnut and cinnamon sugar. Warm like a mug in cold hands.

name: Spiced Pear
summary: Baked pear with brown sugar and cardamom.
description: Poached pear, brown sugar and cardamom pods. A soft, fruity treat.

name: Black Pepper & Fig
summary: Cracked pepper over sticky figs.
description: Black pepper, dried fig and a base of cedar. Dry, peppery and a little sweet.

name: Cinnamon Bark
summary: Warm cinnamon stick and sweet orange.
description: Ceylon cinnamon, orange blossom and nutmeg. A cosy scent for the colder months.

name: Saffron & Oud
summary: Golden saffron over smoky oud.
description: Saffron threads, oud wood and a glow of leather. Our richest and most complex candle.

name: Ginger Spice
summary: Fresh ginger with allspice and a lick of lime.
description: Sharp ginger, allspice berry and lime zest. Lively, zesty and warm.
